sql_templates.name: fii_dii_regime_breadth_index_overview
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, r.regime, r.confidence, b.market_sentiment, i.close AS index_close
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE f.trade_date = (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_date)
AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50';

sql_templates.description: Find current open trades using live TradingView data.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT ph.symbol, ph.qty, ss.stage, ss.technical_score, ss.investment_score 
                FROM portfolio.holdings ph 
                JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON ph.symbol = ss.symbol
                WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM signals.signal_log sl 
                    WHERE sl.symbol = ph.symbol AND sl.signal = 'BUY' AND sl.date_resolved IS NULL
                )
                LIMIT 100;
